title: instructions would be handy to have
text:
instructions would be handy to have. It really bothers me when I have to go online to read instructions that SHOULD have come with the item. It would not cost much to include them. But...... I am willing to bet that something would not have translated and they would have been laughable. I am beginning to find joy in the poorly translated words that come with many products.

Overall, these things have a nice look and feel to them. Once you ruin a few batches and get it figured out, it is not too bad. Yes, silicone can get very hot in the microwave, be forwarned.

I have a feeling we will be using this much more now that the popcorn that we usually buy at the big membership warehouse has doubled in price.

This will also be a handy thing to take in the RV camping.
